name: Radio
description: A radio input component that renders a real <input type="radio"> for accessibility, with a custom-styled visual overlay. Must be used inside a RadioGroup, from which it reads name, selectedValue, onChange, and disabled via context.

notes: A real <input type="radio"> is rendered and visually hidden; the styled circle is a presentation layer.
Must be used inside a RadioGroup which provides name, value, onChange, and disabled via context.
Focus indicator appears on the visual circle via :focus-visible using var(--color-border-focus).
Arrow key navigation is managed by the parent RadioGroup.
The tab index follows ARIA radio group pattern: only the selected (or first) radio is in the tab order.

value.description: The value this radio represents. Compared against RadioGroup's value to determine selected state.

disabled.description: Disables this specific radio. Also disabled if the parent RadioGroup is disabled.

children.description: Label content rendered next to the radio circle.

className.description: Additional CSS class names for the wrapper element.

do: Always use Radio inside a RadioGroup.
Provide a unique value prop for each Radio in the group.
Provide visible label text as children.
dont: Do not use Radio outside of a RadioGroup.
Do not use Radio for non-exclusive choices — use Checkbox instead.
Do not leave a radio without a label.
